preconditions.description: Attacker must hold some DCAKE tokens to be eligible for dividend distribution
Attacker must have some CAKE tokens to transfer to the dividend tracker contract

exploit_hint: The exploit leverages the public `distributeDividends(uint256 amount)` function in the DividendPayingToken contract. First, approve the CAKE dividend tracker to spend your CAKE tokens. Then call `distributeDividends(amount)` on the CAKE dividend tracker contract with a fabricated amount, which will increase the `magnifiedDividendPerShare` and `totalDividendsDistributed`. Finally, call the `claim()` function on the main DogeCake contract to withdraw the illegitimate dividends. Repeat the same process for the DOGE dividend tracker if desired.
